column1: # It Takes Two on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Hazelight / Electronic Arts, Unreal Engine 4 with NVN, Switch version 1.0.2 (v131072).
# Tested on the OPPO OPD2409 (SM8750P, Android 17): the full game, all chapters, with the alpha13
# runtime; 60 fps target. The title, the opening, the hub and the chapters play; saves and chapter
# selection work. The known remaining issues are the sRGB window-surface fallback and alias stale reads.
# alpha19: no CPU pinning. CPU 4/5 stayed at 1.2-1.6 GHz (the cluster governor reads the whole cluster's load, not
# one pinned thread), and the two hot threads lost the other cores: 24.3 avg against 30.6 unpinned. The GPU is the
# limiter now (41 ms a frame at 1500-2000 draws), so leave the scheduler alone.
# alpha21: the system Qualcomm driver renders this title's colour targets through UBWC format lists of its own;
# disable the colour list (keep the depth one) to test whether the wrong materials are that path. Turnip ignores it.
